native_sources.name: phpmailer_init

native_sources.name: wp_new_user_notification()
native_sources.notes: Example native event-specific mail flow; not a generic authored template catalog.

records.label: Template Identity / Category / Lifecycle / Revision
records.notes: WordPress core has no generic reusable email-template Definition/lifecycle product.

records.label: Subject / Preheader / Locale / HTML-Plaintext Mode
records.notes: wp_mail() supplies subject/message/headers and content-type substrate; preheader, locale and template-mode semantics remain WPE-owned.

records.label: Reusable Shell / Header / Footer
records.notes: No native reusable email shell/header/footer system exists.

records.label: Logo / Color / Typography / Contact References
records.notes: Native sender/site metadata may be inputs, but WordPress core has no email-brand token system.

records.label: Section / Columns / Text / Heading
records.notes: Native mail accepts message content but provides no typed email block renderer.

records.label: Button / Image / Divider / Spacer
records.notes: Email-safe action/media blocks remain WPE/market renderer semantics.

records.label: Bounded Repeater / Legal / Dynamic / Conditional Blocks
records.notes: Dynamic content must use bounded registered providers/tokens; native core does not provide an authored executable template language.

records.label: Typed Token Schema / Null Fallback
records.notes: No native typed email-token schema exists.

records.label: Locale Fallback / Plaintext Generation & Override
records.notes: Core contains locale-aware event-specific mail flows, but deterministic locale fallback/plaintext generation remains WPE renderer policy.

records.label: Reviewed WordPress Event Adapter Reference
records.notes: Only reviewed stable core event adapters/filters may be referenced; generic arbitrary string/global mail interception is not an authored option.

records.label: Certified Third-Party Adapter
records.notes: Third-party overrides require certified adapters and remain market/provider compatibility work.

records.label: Sender Profile Reference
records.notes: wp_mail_from/wp_mail_from_name are native sender metadata substrate; credentials, verification and provider transport stay external and secret-free.

records.label: Attachment References / Count / Size / MIME Policy
records.notes: wp_mail() supports attachment paths; authorization, count/size/MIME rules and protected-file access remain WPE/resource-owner policy.

records.label: Preview / Test / Preflight Diagnostics
records.notes: WordPress core has no template preview/client preflight product.

records.label: Secret-Free Import/Export / Revision Compile Cache
records.notes: Email-definition portability/cache semantics are WPE/Import-Export concerns, not native mail transport.

records.label: Raw PHP / Script / Untrusted HTML
records.notes: Raw PHP/script/untrusted executable HTML remains rejected; renderer/providers must be bounded and registered.

coverage.notes: Native wp_mail()/PHPMailer/filter/core-event provenance is integrated without misclassifying transport primitives as an email-template product. Template/layout/block/token/provider semantics remain for market review; raw executable content stays rejected.
